name: Kizaki Kanami
source:
Haruki and Sae's youngest daughter she's a first year student in high school. She loves her father the most and hates to be separated from him even for two weeks while she and [url=http://vndb.org/c9421]Sena[/url] live with their mother. A very sweet girl she gets embarrassed around her father easily because of her feelings for him.

Although she would love to become lovers with her father whom she adores but she would never do something to hurt her mother.
